musiques.prompt: Instrumental hybrid orchestral trailer score with a memorable four-note signature motif, 120 BPM, D minor resolving to F major. 0-1.5 s: no instruments, a deep sub-bass swell. 1.5-4 s: the four-note motif alone on a celesta. 4-6.5 s: dry ticking pulse and fast riser. 6.5 s exact: HUGE drop: taikos, low brass stabs, distorted cello ostinato, driving. 12.5 s: big hit. 13.5-17.5 s: pull back to one sustained low brass note and sub rumble. 17.5-26.5 s: drums return, brass plays the motif, rising. 26.5-27.2 s: complete silence. 27.2-31.5 s: pulsing groove. 31.5-34 s: snare roll and riser. 34-34.5 s: total silence. 34.5 s: the biggest moment: full orchestra and choir play the motif triumphantly in F major. 42.5-47.5 s: drops to the motif alone on celesta. 47.5 s: one final deep boom. 50.5-54.5 s: the motif as a playful pizzicato, ending cleanly at 55 s.

Instrumental cinematic electronic and heavy percussion score, thrilling and fun, 120 BPM, a memorable four-note synth motif. 0-4 s: near silence, sub swell, the motif once on a muted synth. 4-6.5 s: riser. 6.5 s: big drop: hybrid drums, pulsing bass, brass hits. 13.5-17.5 s: pull back to a drone. 17.5-26.5 s: drums rebuild. 26.5-27.2 s: silence. 27.2-34 s: rising build. 34-34.5 s: silence. 34.5-42.5 s: full climax, the motif on huge synth brass. 42.5-47.5 s: motif alone. 47.5 s: final boom. 50.5-55 s: light playful outro.

Hybrid orchestral trailer, 120 BPM, four-note celesta motif, sub-bass intro, huge drop at 6.5 seconds, quiet from 13.5 to 17.5 seconds, build, silence at 34 seconds, triumphant choir climax at 34.5 seconds, quiet celesta at 42.5 seconds, final boom at 47.5 seconds, playful pizzicato ending.
